# Introduction
I will take a look at Frechet distance, dynamic time warping, and maybe some other metrics and assess how well they might perform and how they work. I'll then try to implement them into a practice dataset and then the given dataset.

```{r}
hsa_state = read.csv("hsa_state_inc.csv")
head(hsa_state)

colorado688 = hsa_state[hsa_state$hsa_nci_id==688,]
```

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
ggplot(colorado688) + geom_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1, (aes(x=seq_len(148), y=inc_hsa))) + geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1, (aes(x=seq_len(148), y=inc_state))) + labs(x="index (weeks, 2022 Week 39 to 2025 Week 30)", y = "infected_value (?)", title = "Local vs. state inc values for HSA ID 688 in Colorado") + theme_minimal()
```

# Metrics
## Frechet distance
```{r}
discrete_frechet = function(P, Q, dist_fun = NULL) {
  # P: n x d matrix or data.frame
  # Q: m x d matrix or data.frame
  # dist_fun: function(x, y) returning scalar distance
  
  if (is.null(dist_fun)) {
    dist_fun = function(x, y) sqrt(sum((x - y)^2))
  }
  
  P = as.matrix(P)
  Q = as.matrix(Q)
  
  n = nrow(P)
  m = nrow(Q)
  
  # distance matrix
  dist_mat = matrix(0, n, m)
  for (i in 1:n)
    for (j in 1:m)
      dist_mat[i, j] = dist_fun(P[i, ], Q[j, ])
  
  # DP table
  D = matrix(Inf, n, m)
  Prev = array(NA_integer_, dim = c(n, m, 2))
  
  # initialization
  D[1, 1] = dist_mat[1, 1]
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    D[i, 1] = max(D[i - 1, 1], dist_mat[i, 1])
    Prev[i, 1, ] = c(i - 1, 1)
  }
  
  for (j in 2:m) {
    D[1, j] = max(D[1, j - 1], dist_mat[1, j])
    Prev[1, j, ] = c(1, j - 1)
  }
  
  # DP recursion
  for (i in 2:n) {
    for (j in 2:m) {
      candidates = c(
        D[i - 1, j],
        D[i, j - 1],
        D[i - 1, j - 1]
      )
      
      k = which.min(candidates)
      
      if (k == 1) Prev[i, j, ] = c(i - 1, j)
      if (k == 2) Prev[i, j, ] = c(i, j - 1)
      if (k == 3) Prev[i, j, ] = c(i - 1, j - 1)
      
      D[i, j] = max(dist_mat[i, j], candidates[k])
    }
  }
  
  # backtrack optimal path
  i = n; j = m
  path = matrix(c(i, j), ncol = 2)
  
  while (!(i == 1 && j == 1)) {
    p = Prev[i, j, ]
    i = p[1]; j = p[2]
    path = rbind(c(i, j), path)
  }
  
  # stepwise Frechet values
  step_dist = apply(path, 1, function(idx)
    dist_mat[idx[1], idx[2]]
  )
  
  frechet_steps = cummax(step_dist)
  
  list(
    frechet = D[n, m],
    path = path,
    step_distance = step_dist,
    frechet_by_step = frechet_steps
  )
}

```

```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
P = as.matrix(colorado688$inc_hsa)
Q = as.matrix(colorado688$inc_state)

res = discrete_frechet(P, Q)

res$frechet                  # final discrete Fréchet distance
head(res$frechet_by_step)    # distance as path progresses

ggplot() + geom_line(aes(x=seq_len(272), y=res$frechet_by_step), linewidth = 1) + theme_minimal() + labs(x="Steps", y="Fréchet distance", title = "Fréchet distance by step")
```

## Dynamic time warping
```{r}
dtw_distance <- function(P, Q, dist_fun = NULL) {
  # P, Q: numeric vectors or matrices (rows = time points)
  if (is.null(dist_fun)) dist_fun <- function(x, y) sqrt(sum((x - y)^2))
  
  P <- as.matrix(P)
  Q <- as.matrix(Q)
  
  n <- nrow(P)
  m <- nrow(Q)
  
  # distance matrix
  dist_mat <- matrix(0, n, m)
  for (i in 1:n) for (j in 1:m)
    dist_mat[i,j] <- dist_fun(P[i, ], Q[j, ])
  
  # cumulative cost matrix
  D <- matrix(Inf, n, m)
  D[1,1] <- dist_mat[1,1]
  
  # initialize first row/column
  for (i in 2:n) D[i,1] <- dist_mat[i,1] + D[i-1,1]
  for (j in 2:m) D[1,j] <- dist_mat[1,j] + D[1,j-1]
  
  # fill rest of matrix
  for (i in 2:n) {
    for (j in 2:m) {
      D[i,j] <- dist_mat[i,j] + min(D[i-1,j], D[i,j-1], D[i-1,j-1])
    }
  }
  
  # backtrack optimal path
  i <- n; j <- m
  path <- matrix(c(i,j), ncol = 2)
  while (!(i == 1 && j == 1)) {
    if (i == 1) { j <- j-1 }
    else if (j == 1) { i <- i-1 }
    else {
      # choose minimum predecessor
      k <- which.min(c(D[i-1,j-1], D[i-1,j], D[i,j-1]))
      if (k == 1) { i <- i-1; j <- j-1 }
      else if (k == 2) { i <- i-1 }
      else { j <- j-1 }
    }
    path <- rbind(c(i,j), path)
  }
  
  # stepwise cumulative cost along path
  step_cost <- dist_mat[path]
  cum_cost <- cumsum(step_cost)
  
  list(
    dtw_distance = D[n,m],
    path = path,
    step_cost = step_cost,
    cum_cost = cum_cost
  )
}
```

```{r}
P <- as.matrix(colorado688$inc_hsa)
Q <- as.matrix(colorado688$inc_state)

res_dtw <- dtw_distance(P, Q)

res_dtw$dtw_distance      # final DTW cumulative cost
head(res_dtw$cum_cost)    # running cumulative cost along optimal path

plot(res_dtw$cum_cost, type = "l",
     xlab = "Alignment step",
     ylab = "Cumulative DTW cost",
     main = "DTW cumulative cost along optimal path")
```
